anti_analysis: Silent early exit (return 0) when a debugger is detected - injection is skipped entirely
Dynamic API resolution (GetModuleHandleA/GetProcAddress) hides all ntdll usage from the static import table
Use of undocumented native NT APIs instead of Win32 equivalents to evade import-based detection
TLS callbacks present but are standard MinGW CRT (__mingw_TLScallback), not malicious
PE timestamp is in the future (2026-07-28), likely forged/irrelevant

decoded_strings.ntdll_exports_resolved_at_runtime: ntdll.dll: NtQueryInformationProcess, NtCreateProcess, NtAllocateVirtualMemory, NtWriteVirtualMemory, NtCreateThreadEx, NtResumeThread, NtClose
decoded_strings.payload_note: Decrypted 64 bytes are neither valid x86-64 code (offset 0 = 0x6D 'insd', privileged; offset 0x12 = 0x2F invalid in 64-bit) nor ASCII text - appears to be a dummy/placeholder payload that would crash the child process when executed

encryption_details.algorithm: XOR with repeating key (data[i] ^= key[i % keylen])
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in plaintext in .rdata at VA 0x140004000 (file offset 0x2400), not null-terminated, immediately followed by plaintext "ntdll.dll" and the NT API name strings; the encrypted 64-byte payload blob sits in .data at VA 0x140003000

file_type: PE32+ executable (console) x86-64, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped to external PDB

injection_details.entry_point: WinMain-style function at 0x14000194B (reached via CRT main wrapper tail-jmp at 0x140002DB2) - runs anti-debug check first, then decrypts and injects
injection_details.execution_method: NtCreateThreadEx(&hThread, THREAD_ALL_ACCESS(0x1FFFFF), NULL, hProcess, payloadBase, NULL, 0,0,0,0,NULL) starting a remote thread directly at the injected payload, followed by NtResumeThread(hThread), WaitForSingleObject(hThread, 5000ms), NtClose(hThread), NtClose(hProcess)
injection_details.extra: After injecting, the injector sleeps 2000ms and exits. Decrypted payload is a 64-byte dummy blob (not valid code) in this sample
injection_details.method: Process injection / hollowing-style via undocumented native NT APIs: NtCreateProcess to spawn a new child process object, NtAllocateVirtualMemory to allocate RWX memory in it, NtWriteVirtualMemory to write the decrypted 64-byte payload, NtCreateThreadEx + NtResumeThread to execute it
injection_details.payload_write: 64-byte buffer copied from .data (VA 0x140003000) to stack, XOR-decrypted with repeating key "Gh0stPr0c3ssH0ll0w", then written into the child at the allocated base via NtWriteVirtualMemory; memory allocated by NtAllocateVirtualMemory(Process, &base=NULL, 0, &size=0x40, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40)
injection_details.target_discovery: No process enumeration. The injector opens ITSELF with OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS=0x80, FALSE, GetCurrentProcessId()) and passes that handle as the ParentProcess argument to NtCreateProcess(&hProcess, PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS=0x1FFFFF, &objAttributes, hSelf, 0,0,0,0), creating a fresh child process parented to the injector
injection_details.target_process: A new child process created at runtime by NtCreateProcess (self-spawned; no external target such as explorer.exe)

techniques: dynamic_api_resolution (GetModuleHandleA("ntdll.dll") + GetProcAddress for all NT APIs, function 0x1400014EF)
process_injection_native_ntapi (NtCreateProcess + NtAllocateVirtualMemory + NtWriteVirtualMemory + NtCreateThreadEx + NtResumeThread, function 0x140001614)
process_hollowing_style_self_spawn (new child process parented to self via OpenProcess(PROCESS_CREATE_PROCESS) on own PID; key string "Gh0stPr0c3ssH0ll0w")
